purpose: Preregistered forward test of the CORRECTED receiving-yards pipeline (N8 parity fix): the props-v1 opportunity-efficiency engine fed the receiving-yards share view (app/src/lib/sports/nfl/receiving-yards-share-view.mjs), which restores the allocation rule the 2025 retrospective evaluated (raw walk-forward decayed target shares; modelled receivers scaled among themselves only when their own sum exceeds 1) in place of the role-share builder's roster-wide normalisation. Every other component, bar and counting rule is the served series' (data/internal/research/nfl/reports/player-props-v1-reception-yds-forward-protocol-s3.json). This file adds no model constant, bar, threshold or decision rule.

registration.instant: The git committer time of the commit that ADDS this file. A file cannot carry its own commit, so that commit is pinned in CODE (app/src/lib/sports/nfl/props-v1-forward-registration.mjs PINNED_REGISTRATIONS) by a follow-up commit. The grader refuses unless the pinned commit is an ancestor of the grading commit and is the commit that first added this file: a squash or rebase merge fails loudly instead of silently re-registering later (which would move firstWeek).
registration.immutability: The grader reads this file at its registration commit and at the grading commit and refuses to grade if the two differ. Any amendment needs a new protocol file with its own registration, and founder approval.

model.servedModelRule: The model a served family names is the board's own record, read by the product gate's rule (app/src/lib/products/engine-v2/nfl-boards.mjs modelVersionFor): an explicit `model` field, else the <id>-v<n> that opens its basis. The board builder (app/scripts/nfl/build-nfl-player-board.mjs) writes basis 'props-v1 evaluation: n=<n>, all promotion bars pass' for this engine.

model.identityRule: Fingerprint scope = what moves a served receiving-yards number, traced from run-nfl-event-window.mjs (role rates, strength, matchup totals, runs, seed date) → simulatePlayerProps → board copy: the engine file; the helper declarations it imports, hashed by their own source (kind symbol); strength-state.mjs whole (strengthStateAt, ELO_PARAMS, HOME_ADVANTAGE and everything they reference); the fit block of the evaluation receipt (kind jsonKey); the three matchup-totals files; the role-share builder and estimator; and the orchestrator declarations that feed the engine — arg, NOW, DATE, RUNS, finals, currentShares, propsFit, the two verdict paths, integrationAdopted, totalsReceipt, useMatchupTotals, THRESH, composeRoleRates, and the per-event block extracted (behaviour-preserving) into eventSimInputs and eventTeamPlayerProps. Per event the components are hashed AT THE BOARD REVISION COMMIT (git log on the board path returns the event-window job's own commit, whose tree is the generating tree plus its outputs; a push-retry merge commit is TREESAME to it for the board path and is not returned). pipelineVersionOf(components) must equal series.pipelineVersion for the event to count; any other version is OTHER_PIPELINE_VERSION and is never pooled here. Not in scope (reviewed): the rest of game-sim.mjs (simulateNflGame feeds the team markets, not the props call), artifact-modes.mjs, the evaluator script and the evaluation file outside its fit block. PLUS (this series): the board's own receiving-yards family must carry pipelineVersion === series.boardPipelineLabel (classifyEvent). The served series' fingerprint components are all unchanged by this fix (it sits outside them), so the label is what separates the two: a served-series board names no label, a board of this series names "props-v1+recyds-share-view-v1".
model.attributedNotFrozen: Recorded per event, not part of the version: the sha256 of data/internal/research/nfl/role-shares-v1/current.json (the weekly role-share ARTIFACT the board was built from) and of app/scripts/nfl/build-nfl-player-board.mjs (row gating and labels) at the revision commit. Other per-event inputs (rosters, injuries, totals) are inputs, not identity.

orchestratorRefactorCheck.change: run-nfl-event-window.mjs: the per-event strength / totals / props block moved into the top-level functions eventSimInputs and eventTeamPlayerProps so it can be fingerprinted; no behaviour change.
orchestratorRefactorCheck.method: Same checkout, same inputs: run-nfl-event-window.mjs --now <T> --lookahead-hours 18, then build-nfl-player-board.mjs --now <T>, with the pre-refactor script and with the refactored one; sha256 of every written event artifact and player board compared, then the outputs restored (nothing committed).
orchestratorRefactorCheck.result: every file byte-identical before and after (sha256 equal)

series.rule: Series s4 of the props-v1 receiving-yards forward test: the corrected (receiving-yards share view) pipeline. Registered in a DRAFT branch; it counts only from the first week whose first kickoff is after its pinned registration commit, and only boards that name its label and match its fingerprint — never earlier, never pooled with the served series. If it lands after its registration week, it must be re-registered (new pinned commit) so firstWeek follows the ship date.

source.what: PROMOTION POLICY code (coverOk, calOk, enoughN, ECE bins and usable-bin minimum, line proxy, share params)
promotionPolicy[0] text, cross-checked against the code

propsV1Promotion.readBy: app/src/lib/sports/nfl/props-v1-forward-receipt.mjs readPropsV1PromotionBars — the grader re-reads both sources at the registration commit and refuses if any value below differs
propsV1Promotion.barsJudged: beatsRolling (MAE of the served mean < rolling-4 MAE), beatsShareVol (< share×volume MAE), coverOk (p10–p90 coverage inside coverageBand, inclusive), calOk (threshold ECE ≤ eceMax over bins holding ≥ eceMinBinN pairs)

shareLevelLevel.reportedSeparately: The share-level forward level bar (mean forecast / mean actual) is reported beside the verdict and is NOT part of it: the props-v1 promotion bars have no level clause.

pOver.method: quantile-interpolation-v1: piecewise-linear CDF through the five served quantiles (p10, p25, median, p75, p90), extended past the outer knots with the adjacent segment's slope, clamped to [0, 1] (props-v1-forward-receipt.mjs pOverFromQuantiles, exactly as PR 1363); step bounds recorded beside each value.
pOver.reconstructed: The board serves NO P(over) for this family. The calibration bar therefore uses a RECONSTRUCTED probability: the interpolated P(over) at the RECONSTRUCTED rolling-4 line proxy (the evaluator's rule: mean of the player's last lineProxyGames games at his current team, only when he has exactly that many and the mean is > 0).

schedule.source: app/public/data/nfl/schedule/capture-*.json and latest.json at the grading commit (ESPN scoreboard captures). Union of every capture; the latest capture of each providerEventId wins (captures ordered by generatedAt).
schedule.regularSeason: seasonType 2, cut at the next season's Week 1.
schedule.kickoff: Per event, the earlier of the schedule's dateUtc and the board's own kickoffUtc at the grading commit (the stricter cut).

firstWeekRule: firstWeek = the first regular-season week whose FIRST kickoff (schedule) is strictly after the registration instant. Computed by the grader from the committed schedule; never written as a literal. Weeks before firstWeek NEVER count toward the forward n, even games in them that kick off after registration.

counting.revision: For each event, the LAST revision of app/public/data/nfl/player-board/<eventId>.json in the grading commit's history whose git committer time AND own generatedAt are both strictly before kickoff. A revision committed or generated at/after kickoff is never read for grading. A git commit is not Vercel served-revision evidence (forecast-of-record Option B).
counting.attribution: Per event: family state, family basis, served model, engine id, board revision commit, its committer time, board generatedAt, and the frozen-file identity check.
counting.settlement: props-v1 participation-true contract, exactly as PR 1363 (props-v1-forward-receipt.mjs settleServedPlayer): on the committed ESPN stat sheet (data/internal/research/nfl/player-events-v1/2026.json) with a target or carry → SCORED at his receiving yards; on the sheet with neither → VOID; off the sheet with offensive snaps (data/internal/research/nfl/nflverse/participation-2026.jsonl) → SCORED at 0; otherwise VOID. Only SCORED rows score.
counting.baselines: rolling-4 and share×volume baselines and the line proxy: the props-v1 evaluator's walk-forward rule over the committed ESPN corpus 2023–2026, with the evaluation receipt's committed fit (props-v1-forward-receipt.mjs walkForwardBaselines). RECONSTRUCTED, labelled so.
counting.denominator: Every regular-season event of a counted week is GRADED or carries one exclusion code with its reason. The expected set is re-derived from the raw ESPN schedule captures (expectedScheduledIds), independently of the event list the receipt is built from; the receipt refuses unless its scheduled events are exactly that set. Boards whose own week is that week but which are absent from the schedule are added as board-only events.
counting.pendingCodes: PENDING_KICKOFF, PENDING_NOT_FINAL, PENDING_NO_SNAP_SHEET hold the whole week back; the week is written once they clear. In the summary a started week waiting on kickoffs is IN_PROGRESS; a week whose games have all kicked off but which still has a non-final game (e.g. cancelled) or a missing snap sheet is HELD, listed with each blocking event and its reason. A HELD week stays HELD: any timeout or partial-week rule needs founder approval.
counting.appendOnly: One file per week (data/internal/research/nfl/replay/props-v1-reception-yds-forward/registered/<series>/<season>-wk<NN>.json), written once and never rewritten. A later correction to the corpus does not edit a written week.
counting.deterministic: Every input is read at the grading commit; outputs carry no wall-clock field.
counting.isolation: Each week is graded in isolation: an exception in one week is recorded in the summary (erroredWeeks) and the remaining weeks are still graded; the run then exits non-zero so the failure is visible.

verdictRule: n (SCORED player-games over counted weeks) below minimumN → ACCUMULATING (no verdict); every props-v1 promotion bar passes → FORWARD_HOLDING; otherwise FORWARD_BREACHED. Same rule as forward-player-props-share-level.mjs.
automation: .github/workflows/nfl-props-forward-shadow.yml (the P300 shadow job) runs scripts/research/nfl/forward-props-v1-reception-yds-registered.mjs after its own grade and forecast steps and commits only data/internal/research/nfl/replay/props-v1-reception-yds-forward/registered/ (this series: registered/s3/).
retrospective: No forward evidence exists for this pipeline. The as-served rebuild (2026 weeks 1, 4-9) and the 2025 retrospective comparison are research evidence only and never enter this series' n.
consequence: Research evidence only. No board label, eligibility state or public number changes because of this protocol; activating the corrected pipeline is a founder decision (draft PR, founder go/no-go before merge).

supersedes.why: Series s2 (registered 2026-11-16T01:13:49Z, commit 3f8ff69abb) missed two inputs that move a served receiving-yards number: (1) strength-state.mjs — the engine reads strengthState.ratingFor (player-props-v1.mjs:150) → margin → own pass volume via fit.volume.pass.a1 → targets → receiving yards, so its claim that strength only feeds the team stream was false; (2) the per-event block of run-nfl-event-window.mjs (strength cut and season regression, abbr→name mapping, totals merge, runs: min(RUNS, 5000)) and the arg / NOW / DATE / finals / currentShares / propsFit / verdict-path declarations. A reviewer changed the run cap, regressToSeason and HOME_ADVANTAGE and the s2 version did not move. Nothing had counted (first week 11 not started). Superseded before its first week.
